The '''Dromund Kalakar shipyards''' served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], producing the [[VX-9 Mailoc]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] [[Mission to the Dromund Kalakar shipyards|stole]] the VX-9 Mailoc design specifications, and had the designs used to make the VX-9 Redeemers.
